title: An Amazing Sagrada Família Tour with an Exceptional Guide!
text: Our guide, Xavier, was not only incredibly knowledgeable about the Sagrada Família but also genuinely kind and attentive, making everyone feel comfortable throughout the tour. I was particularly impressed by his detailed explanation of the Nativity and Passion façades, especially the striking Cubist-style sculptures. Thanks to him, I feel like I was able to fully appreciate every detail of this extraordinary basilica. I highly recommend this tour!

title: Absolutely incredible! I...
text: Absolutely incredible! I think it was really worth it to have the explanation of all of the sculptures and the guided walk through of the church. My guide was so knowledgeable and I learned a lot. We got to skip any lines and go right in, and the experience did not feel rushed. Also afterwards you can stay at the church as long as you like.
author: Sarah_R

title: Sagrada Família - Must See
text:
The Tower tour requires a special ticket and they aren’t open every day. If seeing the Tower is important to you plan accordingly.

This tour was just the right duration for us. We appreciate the headsets to hear our guide because it’s loud and busy in the church. 

Our guide was so helpful and friendly. She taught us a lot about Gaudy and the church. She personalized the experience by remembering names and countries of origin. 

This is a must see. It’s magical and like nothing else you’ve seen. The stained glass alone will blow your mind. 

Viator always is reliable to be on time and deliver
author: Valerie_H
